scan_policy.fields: Scan each benchmark text field independently.
scan_policy.near_match_scope: Count shingle overlap within each individual training document only.
scan_policy.substring_alignment: Search complete normalized benchmark fields at all offsets in each training document.
scan_policy.input_identity: Require the benchmark file hash and row count to match its frozen manifest.
scan_policy.test_opening: Refuse to open benchmark files until candidate, tokenizer, training corpus, parser, evaluator, claim and benchmark manifest are frozen.
scan_policy.single_open: Create an atomic run marker before reading benchmark rows; refuse retries after success or interruption.

evidence_boundary: Infrastructure contract only until run against frozen evaluation inputs; short unassessed fields, any overlaps, or input identity mismatches block a clean result.
